scenarios.title: Create a project from a starter
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: one persistent project with exactly one PM and revision 1 exists independently of any goal.
scenarios.errors_recovery: missing input or scope shows an inline error and preserves the draft; admission/binding failure blocks activation and links to the failed gate; save failure retains the entire draft for retry.

scenarios.title: Create a portfolio observer
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: an ordinary Project targets all current/future projects and has no implied write authority over them.
scenarios.errors_recovery: dynamic scope without operator confirmation remains blocked; an effect-level connection binding is rejected unless a specific grant exists.

scenarios.title: Add or replace an admitted agent
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the project gains the agent capability; existing runs remain pinned and routines retain their identities and schedules.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a grant above project ceiling is blocked; revision conflict shows the newer diff and asks the operator to reapply the draft.

scenarios.title: Provider cannot be bound
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: no project access is created and no discovered provider is presented as compatible merely because it exists.
scenarios.errors_recovery: registry unavailable is separate from admission failure; retry registry or complete the named Fabric compatibility gate.

scenarios.title: Connect and scope an external account
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: one estate connection is reused through a narrower versioned project binding and secret values never enter project configuration.
scenarios.errors_recovery: OAuth expiry offers retry; no selected resource/agent blocks save; removed resource marks only that binding stale and offers reselection.

scenarios.title: Scan all project cards
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can identify which project and dimension needs attention without accepting an unsupported composite status.
scenarios.errors_recovery: projector failure keeps last data as stale with retry; one source failure affects only its dimension.

scenarios.title: Open an affected project from attention
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the source of attention is traceable from estate card to project and exact run/observation.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a missing receipt is displayed as unverified with refresh/trace recovery, never replaced by an agent conclusion.

scenarios.title: Inspect and recover a run
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator understands what became true and performs at most one authorised recovery action.
scenarios.errors_recovery: reconnect resumes from monotonic event id; unauthorised action preserves the run and opens approval; retry exhaustion returns best partial result.

scenarios.title: Replace an agent without moving its routine
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: schedule and history survive provider replacement; only future runs use the successor binding.
scenarios.errors_recovery: no eligible replacement leaves the routine waiting/disabled with a named reason; active run is never rebound.

scenarios.title: Observer submits a proposal

scenarios.expected_result: evidence crosses the project boundary as a proposal, not a direct graph or memory write.
scenarios.errors_recovery: target missing/retired or PM unavailable leaves the finding unresolved with a recoverable routing error.

scenarios.title: Target PM resolves a proposal once

scenarios.expected_result: target project retains decomposition authority and the same proposal cannot produce duplicate work.
scenarios.errors_recovery: already-resolved proposal shows the existing resolution and disables duplicate action; stale evidence blocks resolution until refreshed.

scenarios.title: Promote memory through an accepted artifact
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: no project writes another project's memory directly and every promoted fact retains provenance.
scenarios.errors_recovery: missing evidence/confidence blocks promotion; contradictory estate knowledge requires explicit supersession rather than overwrite.

scenarios.title: Join an estate with explicit roles
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the person joins with informed, attributable scope and receives no credential or implicit access outside the declared roles.
scenarios.errors_recovery: expired or changed invitation offers refresh/contact-owner; partial acceptance is not silently inferred.

scenarios.title: Resolve an interaction from a role workspace
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: one human contribution closes or advances the interaction without duplicate effects or unrelated estate exposure.
scenarios.errors_recovery: already-resolved item opens the existing receipt; denied effect preserves the draft and requests a grant; stale evidence requests refresh.

scenarios.title: Adapt an existing repository into a provider
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the existing project remains architecturally owned by its author and produces a reproducible provider bundle or a precise failed gate.
scenarios.errors_recovery: integrity mismatch or unreviewed change plan stops before writes; local failure preserves report and offers a regenerated fix recipe.

scenarios.title: Create and admit a new provider
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: exact provider revision is admitted; no project access exists until the separate binding is saved; canary/promotion history remains attached to the revision/binding.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a passing local report cannot override failed independent conformance; binding ceiling/budget failures preserve admission and return to setup.

scenarios.title: Bootstrap or conformance fails safely
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: no admission, binding, credential or partial hidden installation exists; recovery preserves user code and evidence.
scenarios.errors_recovery: cleanup failure lists remaining generated paths without deleting user-owned files; expired short-lived exchange can be reissued without changing the recipe target.

scenarios.title: Add a provider view to a role workspace
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the role gains a useful interface while PassionCode.ai retains layout, permission, accessibility and action authority.
scenarios.errors_recovery: missing fallback, overbroad scope, overlap, invalid span, focus-order failure or unadmitted revision blocks publish, identifies the tile and offers the nearest valid placement/order.

scenarios.title: Resolve a customer request with human fallback
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the customer receives one attributable response; unresolved or sensitive work has one human owner; product work crosses as a proposal rather than a direct backlog mutation.
scenarios.errors_recovery: identity ambiguity requests human selection without merging customers; missing knowledge blocks confident answer; expired grant preserves response draft.

scenarios.title: Turn a production signal into a verified release
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: source signal, accepted work, code/test evidence, authorization, release receipt and recovery observation form one trace.
scenarios.errors_recovery: checker rejection returns to its producer without advancing; unavailable policy fails closed at release; monitor timeout leaves incident unresolved.

scenarios.title: Research, validate, publish and measure content
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: every public artifact is sourced, independently checked, authorized, receipted and connected to its measured feedback.
scenarios.errors_recovery: no channel identity or expired grant blocks publication but preserves approved draft; API failure reconciles before retry to prevent duplicate posts.

scenarios.title: Create and connect scoped MCP access
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the external client is connected through one immutable, expiring Project-scoped binding and no owner session or downstream credential was shared.
scenarios.errors_recovery: missing scope/expiry blocks issuance; failed discovery identifies transport/auth/version/scope layer; a lost one-time value is rotated, never recovered.

scenarios.title: External agent participates within its MCP scope
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the external agent participates through the same Project, policy, journal, checker and durable-Run lifecycle as an internal request.
scenarios.errors_recovery: dropped connection resumes by Task/Run id; conflicting idempotency reuse is rejected; failed/cancelled Run preserves partial evidence and current state.

scenarios.title: MCP access is denied or revoked safely
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: excluded or revoked access produces no unauthorized read/mutation, while existing Run state remains truthful and separately controllable.
scenarios.errors_recovery: failed revocation leaves old status visible and offers retry; cancellation request reports cooperative/current state rather than “cancelled” until proven.

scenarios.title: Work in a project's hosted terminal
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the session is the one the agent actually runs in, typeable and reattachable, and its lifecycle exists as journal events with receipts. It lives in its own window so the project panel stays readable behind it.
scenarios.errors_recovery: spawn failure names the cwd and binary checked and offers retry without journalling an open; a killed PTY marks the tab ended, never silently blank.

scenarios.title: Follow the estate through the journal feed
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the feed is a view over the durable trace (ADR-0027); every fact opens its receipt, and every row is legible to the person being asked to check it. A receipt nobody can read is not a receipt.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a Realtime outage degrades to on-demand replay with a stale banner; the feed never invents order — it shows the table's. An event with no sentence falls back to the RAW TYPE and never to the lookup key: a missing key renders as itself, and `event.task.moved@1` on screen is the identifier plus a prefix that means nothing.

scenarios.title: Approve, refuse or watch the floor refuse
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: escalation is the exception and every resolution carries a receipt; nothing floored happens silently and nothing floored defaults open.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a resolution that fails to persist retries without double-resuming the node (idempotent by question id); policy `indeterminate` is shown as a denial with diagnostics, never as pending.

scenarios.title: Open a project as a tab and configure it
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: projects are browser-like tabs over persistent workspaces; every configuration change is an event with a revision, not a silent mutation.
scenarios.errors_recovery: an empty name blocks the save with the draft preserved; a failed append surfaces the error banner and leaves the header unchanged.

scenarios.title: Launch an agent and open its session window
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: agents are sessions with a visible short status on the project page and a full terminal in their own window; closing a window is not ending work.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a spawn failure names the program and directory and journals nothing as opened; an ended session remains as a dismissible tile with its exit code.

scenarios.title: Read the project workspace canvas
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the workspace exists as a slot layout the operator can read today and providers can render into later, without the layout moving when they do.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a widget whose projection is unavailable states that its evidence is stale instead of rendering zero as a fact.

scenarios.title: Onboard a project in a new tab
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: onboarding is a tab, not a modal; an abandoned draft leaves no trace in the register; a saved project arrives configured rather than empty.
scenarios.errors_recovery: an empty name blocks the save with the draft preserved; a failed append leaves the draft editable and shows the error.

scenarios.title: Ask for work and watch what it opened
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: asking for work is one field and one button; what was asked, who was
scenarios.errors_recovery: a spawn failure reports the program and directory and no task is

scenarios.title: Attach and detach repositories
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: a project holds a set of repositories, one of them primary, and the primary is derived rather than typed. What the strip says about them is current, not current-as-of-whenever-the-page-was-opened.
scenarios.errors_recovery: an unreadable folder shows in the file panel as unreadable rather than as empty. A refresh that fails leaves the last good reading with its error carried, rather than blanking the strip or raising a banner every ten seconds.

scenarios.title: Open a file and save it against an agent's edit
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: a file can be edited beside working agents without either side losing
scenarios.errors_recovery: an unreadable or oversized file reports why and the window can be

scenarios.title: Read what an agent says it is doing
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can follow progress without reading a transcript, and can never mistake what an agent asserted for what the system measured.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a claim always carries its age, so a three-hour-old account cannot sit unmarked beside a four-second-old measurement; the surface being down means sessions still run and simply cannot report.

scenarios.title: Read what a finished session actually did
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: what a session did survives the session, the app restarting, and the agent that ran it. The operator's account of the work no longer depends on the agent's own account of it.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a record that cannot be read reports why and the panel stays usable; a capture that could not start leaves the session running normally and simply produces no record.

scenarios.title: See who remembered something, and what memory could not answer
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can tell a fact they wrote from a fact an agent asserted, and can see whether memory is being used and whether it is answering — instead of inferring both from how full it looks.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a retrieval that cannot be recorded never fails the search it was recording — the answer matters more than the bookkeeping, and the failure is logged.

scenarios.title: Evaluate the shift from vibe coding to passion coding
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the reader can explain the category transition, product/kernel boundary and present status without inferring autonomous operation or a public runtime.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a private or unavailable repository is labelled by role rather than offered as a download; no page function depends on a script or external API.

scenarios.title: See what this project remembers, and what it could not answer
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the project's knowledge is inspectable — the operator can say what is stored, who put it there, whether it is being used and whether it answers.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a store that cannot be read never blanks the others; it reports its own failure in its own row.

scenarios.title: Rejoin a project by reading its decisions
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator rejoins the work knowing why it stands where it does, without reading a transcript.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a compile that fails leaves the previous digest visible WITH its age, and says the refresh failed — never a blank band.

scenarios.title: Work a board the agents keep current
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the state of the project's work is a project fact that agents maintain, with every card accountable to a person or an agent by name.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a move that fails to journal snaps back and says so — the board never shows a state the journal does not hold.

scenarios.title: Ask the manager, and get an artefact rather than advice
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: a conversation with the manager terminates in an artefact — a binding, a proposal, a task or a journalled decision — or in nothing, stated.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a creation that fails leaves the specification on screen with the reason, so the operator can fix it rather than retype it.

scenarios.title: Lead with the projects actually being worked
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: a portfolio of many does not bury the two being worked today.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a pin that fails to record leaves the row unchanged and reports it.

scenarios.title: Read what the estate has actually done
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the profile is a measurement surface for the estate, checkable line by line.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a figure whose register cannot be read shows as unavailable with the reason, never as zero.

scenarios.title: Rejoin a task by reading its own page
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can rejoin any piece of work cold, and knows for every line whether a person or an agent put it there.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a resource whose target is gone says so in place and keeps the reference, rather than disappearing and taking the trail with it.

scenarios.title: Judge direction from goals and the graph
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator can name the next dependency before a goal closes and distinguish intended work from recorded history.
scenarios.errors_recovery: partial reads retain known goal/task membership with coverage and age; invalid normative dependency cycle is refused by the command with a named relation; historical cycles are not rejected by that rule.

scenarios.title: See what a project's agents may do, and hold them to it
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: what agents may do in this project is visible, and the rules they follow cannot drift from the product that enforces them.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a server whose grant cannot be read shows as unavailable with the reason; the agent that depends on it does not start and says which grant it is waiting for.

scenarios.title: Find anything the estate holds from one field
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: one door to everything, and an honest account of where the answer was looked for.
scenarios.errors_recovery: a failed store never blanks the page; it reports itself and the rest still answers.

scenarios.title: Watch every agent from one screen
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: the operator moves between agents without opening a project per agent, and can tell in seconds which one needs them.
scenarios.errors_recovery: an agent whose console cannot attach says so and keeps the rest of the screen usable.

scenarios.title: Answer a scoped question and see whether work received it
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The answer is durable and the operator can distinguish decision commit from receipt by the working agent.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Timeout after commit retries the same command ID; a competing answer returns the current receipt; delivery retry never records a second answer or grant; source failure is not an empty Board.

scenarios.title: Inspect a manager settlement and override it by a new decision
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can inspect and correct accountable decisions without a fabricated explanation of model reasoning.
scenarios.errors_recovery: A stale decision or trust revision is revalidated on commit; a rejected override retains input and explains recovery; past effects require their own compensating work.

scenarios.title: Read one execution iteration without confusing report and observation
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can explain what this iteration intended, what was reported, what Fabric observed and what was verified.
scenarios.errors_recovery: A late response for a previous task/run is discarded; a stale feed keeps the last successful snapshot with age; an unavailable detector cannot label the agent stalled.

scenarios.title: Inspect agent history, project history and the target plan as distinct views
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator understands recorded history and intended dependencies without mistaking one for the other.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Missing targets remain boundary stubs with explanation; failed reads preserve the previous snapshot; new live events do not silently replace the selected historical plan.

scenarios.title: Trace how a decision changed and what evidence was supplied
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can reconstruct recorded decision lineage and evidence without any claim to reveal private model reasoning.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Cycles, depth limits, unknown actors and missing refs are visible diagnostics. Scope denial retains the parent record but does not expose the protected source.

scenarios.title: Handle what needs attention and read what happened
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: Unresolved work remains accountable while informational events can be read without becoming another task store.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Receiving an event or failing a read never advances read watermark. Duplicate replay is deduped by source ID. Two operators do not change each other's read state.

scenarios.title: Inspect every cycle and the evidence for its state
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can distinguish disabled, not due, skipped, running, failed and unobserved cycles and act on the actual cause.
scenarios.errors_recovery: DST/sleep/catch-up follows each cycle policy; unknown next due is explicit. DB read failure retains last state with age. No manual wake bypasses admission or starts a duplicate.

scenarios.title: Preview the next context and inspect the exact past pack
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can inspect what a future run would receive and what an earlier run actually received without conflating them.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Rename, brief edits and compiler upgrade never change an old pack hash. Missing historical inputs do not trigger a closest-current substitution. Dry preview has no append/spawn side effects.

scenarios.title: Follow evidence through a collapsed interface without losing context
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: Progressive disclosure reduces overload while every fact and resolving action remains reachable.
scenarios.errors_recovery: No nested buttons, unresolved aria references or color-only meaning; reduced motion retains content; narrow/200% zoom retains the main action and readable inspector.

scenarios.title: Reach first value progressively and resume an unfinished draft
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: A durable project and inspectable first-work intent exist without compulsory repository or full organisational setup; execution readiness remains explicit.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Local persistence failure retains input; conflict preserves the unsaved patch. A create response for another draft/project is not applied. Unknown create outcome is reconciled with the same command identity before another create.

scenarios.title: Return to existing work across projects without losing scope
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator resumes the actual addressed work without leaking context, losing drafts or confusing a link with authority.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Read failures retain the last authorised snapshot with age; revocation clears the protected projection. Passive replay does not advance the operator read watermark. A project-only link is not permission to bypass estate membership.

scenarios.title: Choose and replace a manager with visible authority and host readiness
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: A selectable manager can change without losing project governance or admitting two authoritative writers.
scenarios.errors_recovery: A delayed old-epoch command is refused without domain mutation. Unknown spawn or checkpoint outcome is reconciled before a paid duplicate invocation. Missing authority/pack source blocks dependent admission. Revocation does not pretend a previously completed effect was undone.

scenarios.title: Turn a retrospective episode into a verified lesson and detect regression
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: A retrospective produces attributable corrective work and measured verification instead of merely accumulating repeated feedback.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Duplicate source identity cannot raise the threshold. A stale applicability revision or absent verification source blocks a verified claim. Rebuild/replay retains suppression and episode links; no model self-report substitutes for independent observation.

scenarios.title: Inspect service feedback and stop outbound work honestly
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: The operator can distinguish local improvement data, proposed outbound policy and actual delivery state, including the limits of opt-out after dispatch.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Opt-out cannot recall already dispatched bytes; unknown is not relabelled cancelled. Re-enable, schema migration and replay do not resurrect tombstoned feedback. Restore remains outbound-off/quarantined until current authority and suppression are revalidated.

scenarios.title: Inspect declared storage and import a verified mirror without partial writes
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: A declared-layer import is inspectable, atomic and distinct from full backup recovery or bidirectional synchronisation.
scenarios.errors_recovery: A second concurrent import returns conflict instead of mixing estates. A fault before transaction commit leaves zero committed imported entities; retry uses the same operation/command identity. Failed generation or rebuild retains the previous readable generation.

scenarios.title: Restore a verified backup into a fenced read-only environment
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.
scenarios.expected_result: Restoration preserves evidence without reviving obsolete authority or duplicating uncertain external work.
scenarios.errors_recovery: Fixture backup A → effect acknowledged, opt-out, manager revoked → restore A must not resend the effect, reactivate the manager or enqueue old feedback. Failed or unknown activation is reconciled by the same operation identity, not assumed complete.

scenarios.title: Return from authentication to the same invitation with current membership
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.

scenarios.title: Record a first task and distinguish admission from delivery acknowledgement
scenarios.assessment: Static expected-result and recovery contract compared with all mapped renderers; not a production verdict or full browser execution.

scenarios.errors_recovery: Double submit and post-commit timeout use the same command identity. A late response cannot overwrite another task draft. Unknown dispatch is never an automatic retry; lack of provider acknowledgement remains explicit.
